knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Dry dusting moves particles into the air. The method removes dust by holding it on a damp or dust-control surface.
Routine damp dusting uses detergent and water, and the solution is changed when soiled.
The method starts at the far end and works back toward the door in overlapping passes.

practicalCriteria: Learner completes a sample dust control pass with the head on the floor and figure-of-eight movements, with the assessor marking each step
Learner damp-dusts a sample surface top to bottom with a detergent cloth and states why dry dusting is not used, with both correct
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Assessor observation of the dust control pass
stopWorkCriteria: A dust control head is missing or damaged
A surface is being wet-cleaned while a patient is in the room without the schedule permitting it
